llm_fields.description: A relief scheme launched in 2020 to provide financial support to destitute weavers of Karnataka engaged in the handloom and textile industry whose livelihoods were affected by the Covid pandemic.
llm_fields.eligibility: The beneficiary must be a resident of Karnataka and have a valid resident certificate. All weavers and financially distressed workers engaged in the handloom/power loom industry and ancillary activities such as cotton, wool, and silk in the state are eligible. Prospective beneficiaries must have an active bank account.
